correctedCritiques.pro-brute-cause-insufficient: Strongest feature: By distinguishing a causally basic origin from a comprehensive account of rational intelligibility, the move directly tests whether a brute physical terminus can satisfy the broader affirmative explanatory ambition. Principal limitation: First cause, last cause, teleological completion, and self-actualizing logical foundation remain conceptually underconnected, while the move assumes without independent justification that causal sufficiency must additionally furnish purposive completion. Live burden: The affirmative must explain why rational inference requires teleological termination, establish how its proposed foundation supplies that requirement, and answer the charitable possibility that physical reality is causally basic without being explanatorily exhaustive. Locked score: The mixed band reflects meaningful contact with the central burden and an intelligible challenge to brute explanation, counterbalanced by unstable terminology, insufficient warrant, overextended necessity, and incomplete engagement with the strongest available alternative.
correctedCritiques.pro-logical-moments-trinity: Strongest feature: The move directly attempts the indispensable bridge from an absolute, self-understanding foundation to specifically Christian Trinitarian truth, instead of stopping at generic necessity, mentality, or abstract theism. Principal limitation: The progression from logical moments to distinct divine persons remains unsupported; the Aquinas description and Christian terminology establish neither identity nor entailment, while the exclusive necessity claim substantially exceeds the reasoning provided. Live burden: The affirmative must define universality, particularity, and individuality, derive genuine personal distinction from their relationships, and demonstrate unique correspondence with the Christian Trinity rather than merely suggestive metaphorical resemblance. Locked score: The mixed band recognizes exceptional relevance to the motion and a recoverable constructive proposal, while preserving decisive reservations about evidential warrant, conceptual mapping, calibration, and the absent bridge from logical categories to Trinitarian persons.
